authorization: User approved recommended existing-data audit and dependency relocation into NL-Analytics/CommonModels. No new model integration.

bands.shells_C: fixed integer shells10..20 with half-integer boundaries; no time-varying shell removal

phase_A.near_zero_scale: max(RMS archived quantity, 1e-10*RMS full twin-energy sum)
phase_A.pointwise_diagnostic: report pointwise scaled discrepancies separately; no after-the-fact acceptance threshold
phase_A.reproduce: prespecified unsmoothed shape R, inferred-rate derivative smoothing with unsmoothed denominator/mask, exclusion counts, trajectory medians and two-member means/four-truth median; no new bootstrap

phase_B.derivatives: centered equal-step stencils within cadence segments; native,step2,step4; exclude endpoints, unequal cadence transitions and gaps
phase_B.physical_residuals: sampled-production quadrature and archived allocated interval budget, distinct from temporal product-rule residual
phase_B.full_pure_cancellation: L2(full Ppure)/L2(sum of absolute physical-band Ppure)<=1e-5; report underresolved denominator
phase_B.clocks: use independently archived band tangent columns only, burnin t>=5, no fitted/new clocks
phase_B.curves: unaligned and retrospective half-height aligned individual trajectories; historical RMSE and leave-one-truth-out descriptive sensitivity
phase_B.uncertainty: shared truth groups retained; no bootstrap or null re-run

phase_C.derivatives: fixed shell support, unsmoothed equal-cadence centered 3-point and span2 sensitivity
phase_C.inferred_clock_domain: all fixed shells strictly0<a<1, no selective shell removal; retain negative inferred rates without log
phase_C.arithmetic_tolerance: relative1e-10 term scale +absolute1e-12 characteristic tendency; characteristic=max(RMS DtA, abs(lambda0)*RMS A(1-A), tiny)
phase_C.bound: No claim of independently predictive or certified continuous-trajectory bound when independent shell dynamics/residuals unavailable. Auxiliary piecewise-linear sampled-path a posteriori bound may be evaluated with quadrature error and domain checks explicitly separate.
phase_C.generalization: no new predictive-skill or universal closure claim

resources.pilot: one N256 truth group first; measure wall time and peakRSS before full run
stops: missing quantities or insufficient support for a dependent analysis
